page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and is equipped with 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AES cryptography, and SHA extensions.

The server is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. For local storage, it includes a 236 GB NVMe SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No dedicated GPUs are present on this instance.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25 percent. Multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU scores, and Redis SET operations, which achieve 5.91 million operations per second, sit in the average tier. However, memory read bandwidth and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression show weaker performance, falling into the bottom 25 percent. LLM inference capabilities are moderate for small 135M models but drop significantly for larger 7B models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E4ads_v6 offers a dense memory allocation relative to its vCPU count, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads without paying for excess compute cores. Given its high memory capacity, dedicated AMD EPYC processor, and local NVMe SSD, this server is suitable for relational databases, caching layers, in-memory analytics, and general-purpose workloads requiring a larger memory footprint.
